events.body: Beer company Molson Coors (NYSE:TAP) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 2% year on year to $2.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.62 per share was 71.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
